name: Xiaopu Simbot
summary: Xiaopu Simbot is Simple AI’s wheeled humanoid service robot for household and household-like commercial environments. Its upper body carries two articulated arms and a screen head above a mobile wheeled base. The manufacturer combines perception and manipulation hardware with task planning, memory and interaction software. At the 2026 World Robot Conference, it demonstrated audience interaction and household-style operations such as handling laundry and tidying. These demonstrations establish a physical platform; broad commercial delivery availability remains unverified.
